articles.title: Venezuela Earthquake: One month update – 24 July 2026
articles.description: Country: Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) Source: Médecins Sans Frontières One month following the devastating earthquakes of June 24, Venezuela continues to grapple with the aftermath, facing profound grief as thousands mourn the loss of family, friends, and everything they owned. ​ This sudden natural disaster that affected particularly the coastal state of La Guaira, near Caracas, has transitioned into a complex, protracted crisis characterized by massive population displacement, severe infrastructural damage, and deep psychological trauma. In La Guaira and Caracas, the urgent needs include access to clean water, adequate shelter, mental health care, and protection. ​ The official death toll has reached 5,398, with 16,740 individuals injured, 17,907 displaced, and 6,462 rescued from the rubble. The structural devastation is staggering; 190 buildings have officially collapsed, while over 895 structures, including schools, vital public infrastructure, and hospitals, have suffered severe damage and are at risk of collapse. ​ Thousands are currently residing in makeshift Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) sites or sleeping in tents adjacent to their damaged homes. In Maiquetía (La Guaira), approximately 3,000 individuals are camping on the pavement directly in front of 20 severely damaged and unstable buildings. Similarly, in Avenida Bolívar (Caracas), another 3,000 individuals are living on the streets, stripped of proper shelter and basic services. ​ In response to the crisis, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) currently operates four mobile clinics providing Primary Health Care, Mental Health support, Health Promotion, and WASH activities across the most affected areas: three in La Guaira (Maiquetía, Catia La Mar, and Tamaguarena) and one in Caracas (Avenida Bolívar). These clinics offer primary healthcare, clean water, and emergency mental health interventions to families who have lost everything. In the past month, MSF medical teams have conducted 2,217 medical consultations. The injuries sustained extend beyond physical; families still searching for loved ones beneath the rubble, along with the shock of sudden homelessness and displacement, have given rise to a psychological crisis. To address these mental health challenges, MSF has integrated mental health support into its mobile response, providing: 113 individual mental health, 323 group therapy sessions, 1,402 psycho-education sessions. With local infrastructure severely compromised, MSF teams are implementing water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) intervention: ​ Installed a 5,000-liter water bladder in Playa Verde to serve as a reliable clean water source. Initiated the ongoing chlorination of four primary water distribution sites alongside continuous water purification monitoring. Distributed 5,000 bottles of emergency drinking water to families living on the streets. Over the past month, MSF has donated approximately 8.5 tons of emergency medical supplies. This extensive logistical effort has supported immediate, life-saving operations and addressed the healthcare needs of an estimated 10,000 patients. MSF teams continue to provide disinfectants and Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) materials not only to active hospitals but also to overwhelmed local morgues, ensuring safety, hygiene, and dignity amid unprecedented loss.

articles.title: Philippines: Flash Update: No. 1 – Tropical Cyclone NOUL – 24 July 2026
articles.description: Country: Philippines Source: ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance Please refer to the attached Infographic. OVERVIEW: According to PAGASA ,the tropical depression east of Northern Luzon has intensified into a tropical storm with international name “NOUL.” As of 1000H UTC+7, the centre of Tropical Cyclone NOUL has been located based on all available data about 135 km east of Catanduanes. STRENGTH, EXTENT, & MOVEMENT: According to PAGASA’s Tropical Cyclone Bulletin No. 10 issued at 1000H UTC+7 : Maximum sustained winds at 75 km/h with gustiness up to 90 km/h, minimum central pressure at 996 hPa, moving westward at 30 km/h. Strong to gale-force winds extend outwards up to 450 km from the centre. FORECAST: According to PAGASA Tropical Cyclone Bulletin No. 10 issued at 1000H UTC+7: TRACK: NOUL will continue moving west northwestward until tomorrow (25 July) towards the Luzon Strait before turning northwestward to northward for the remaining forecast period. On the forecast track, the center of NOUL may pass close to the northeastern portion of mainland Cagayan between this morning and afternoon, then pass very close or make landfall in the vicinity of Babuyan Islands between this afternoon and evening. It is forecast to exit the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) by tomorrow morning. INTENSITY: NOUL will continue to intensify while traversing Extreme Northern Luzon and may be upgraded into a severe tropical storm after passing the Babuyan Islands. While moving over the West Philippine Sea, it may undergo rapid intensification and reach typhoon category before making landfall over southern mainland China. Afterwards, NOUL is expected to weaken as it moves inland and interacts with the surrounding terrain of mainland China. TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNALS IN EFFECT: TCWS No. 2 Warning lead time 24 hours, range of wind speeds: 62 to 88 km/h (Beaufort 8 to 9) is raised over the following areas: Batanes, the northern portion of Cagayan including Babuyan Islands, the northern portion of Apayao, and the northern portion of Ilocos Norte. TCWS No. 1 Warning lead time 36 hours, range of wind speeds: 39 to 61 km/h (Beaufort 6 to 7) is raised over the following areas: The rest of mainland Cagayan, Isabela, Quirino, Nueva Vizcaya, the rest of Apayao, Abra, Kalinga, Mountain Province, Ifugao, Benguet, the rest of Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, and La Union, and the northern and central portions of Aurora. HAZARDS: Severe Winds – The wind signals warn the public of the general wind threat over an area due to the tropical cyclone. Local winds may be slightly stronger/enhanced in coastal and upland/mountainous areas exposed to winds. Winds are less strong in areas sheltered from the prevailing wind direction. Minor to moderate impacts from gale-force winds are possible within any of the localities where Wind Signal No. 2 is hoisted. Minimal to minor impacts from strong winds are possible within any of the areas under Wind Signal No. 1. The Southwest Monsoon and the periphery of NOUL will also bring strong to gale-force gusts over the following areas (especially in coastal and upland areas exposed to winds): Today: Most of the country; Tomorrow (25 July): Most of Luzon and Visayas, Zamboanga del Norte, and Davao Oriental; Sunday (26 July): Ilocos Region, MIMAROPA, Zambales, Bataan, and Quezon. Heavy Rainfall – Heavy rainfall outlook due to Tropical Cyclone NOUL and the Southwest Monsoon is issued for the following areas today until tomorrow noon: 100-200 mm: Batanes, Cagayan, Apayao, and Ilocos Norte 50-100 mm: Isabela, Kalinga, Abra, Benguet, Ilocos Sur, and La Union. According to PAGASA , the amount of rainfall may cause the following impacts: 100-200mm rainfall : Numerous flooding events are likely especially in moderate to highly susceptible areas. Landslide likely in moderate to highly susceptible areas. 50-100mm rainfall : Localised flooding is possible mainly in areas that are urbanised, low-lying, or near rivers. Landslide possible in highly susceptible areas. ANTICIPATED RISK: The hoisting of Wind Signal No. 3 is not ruled out should NOUL intensify into a severe tropical storm while traversing the area of Batanes-Babuyan Islands. PREPAREDNESS AND RESPONSE: The NDRRMCOC has raised its Alert Status to BLUE in connection with Tropical Cyclone NOUL (local name “Kiyapo”), coordinating with concerned regional offices and local authorities for tropical cyclone preparedness and response. NDRRMC and PAGASA conducts regular press briefings to update the public about the developments of the weather conditions and preparations for the potential impacts of the tropical cyclone. The DENR-MGB has released the list of barangays at risk of flooding and landslides to support local authorities in their localized preparedness and response measures. The AHA Centre continues to closely monitor the situation in coordination with NDRRMC Philippines and other potentially affected Member States, and remains ready to provide assistance should the need arise.

articles.title: Horoscope for Friday, July 24, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

There are no restrictions to shopping or important decisions today. The moon is in Sagittarius.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

A dynamic day

This is a lovely romantic day! In particular, it's the perfect day to tell someone how much you care for them. This might be a family member or someone who lives with you. It might be a co-worker, and of course, it could be a romantic interest.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

A positive day

All your conversations with others are charming today because you have the gift of gab. Your words are sweet, and people want to hear what you have to say. You might choose to tell siblings, relatives and neighbors something positive — something they will want to hear.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

A positive day

Financial discussions will go well today because you will be tactful, diplomatic and convincing in a subtle way. (They won't even see you coming.) Whatever transpires, you will be the one who is laughing all the way to the bank. You might also shop for beautiful things today.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

A positive day

This is a great day to play hooky. Today you'll enjoy reading for pleasure, socializing, enjoying concerts and doing anything where you can appreciate the beauty and talents of others. Visit art galleries, museums, architectural buildings and parks.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

A dynamic day

Enjoy schmoozing today! Accept invitations to socialize. Sports events, the arts, museums, galleries and fun activities with kids will appeal. This is a very romantic day. New romance can begin, and existing relationships can blossom because it's easy for people to express their affection for each other.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

A positive day

Romance is in the air today, making this a lovely, sociable day! However, it's also an excellent day for you to buy wardrobe goodies. Enjoy the company of friends and groups. Someone's feedback or advice might be helpful. Bonus!

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

A dynamic day

You can make great strides in whatever you want to do today because you make a great impression on parents, bosses, VIPs and the police. You can sweet-talk your way into or out of anything. It's also a popular day for you. Enjoy socializing, reading for amusement, concerts, art exhibits and sports.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

A positive day

This is the perfect day to explore avenues in higher education, publishing, the media, medicine, the law and anything related to travel. Doors will open for you because you're admired, well-spoken and convincing. You will hold people in the palm of your hand.

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

A dynamic day

This is a five-star day for you! The moon is in your sign dancing with lucky, moneybags Jupiter. You will find that financial discussions about shared property and anything jointly held with someone else will favor you. Ka-ching!

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

A positive day

This is the perfect day to tell someone close to you how much they mean to you. Tell them that you care. People love to hear this — we all do. And yet, so many of us leave it up to the imagination of someone very close. Travel plans look appealing!

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

A dynamic day

Some of you might have a crush on a co-worker or a person involved with your health regimen. Whatever the case, today is the day to let someone know that you care. You might also get caught up in competitive sports and athletics because it appeals. Many exciting possibilities today!

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

A dynamic day

This is such a romantic day! Enjoy the company of loved ones. Do something special for your main squeeze. You will also enjoy appreciating the arts and creative work of others because your appreciation of beauty is heightened today.

If today is your birthday

Actress Elisabeth Moss (1982) shares your birthday today. You are energetic, sympathetic and sensitive. You have enthusiasm for what you believe. Exciting changes will bring you increased personal freedom this year. Stay flexible. Let go of whatever holds you back. Seek out new opportunities and be ready to act fast. Trust your intuition. Travel is likely.
